headline.family_guess: serif italic display (Georgia/Playfair-like) mixed with bold sans
headline.case: lowercase for italic-serif accent words, sentence case for sans
headline.size_rel: large, ~2 words per screen, often split across 2 lines

caption.case: lowercase, one-word or 2-3 word burst captions
caption.size_rel: medium-large, sits low-center over host, one phrase revealed per beat

layout.host_pos: center-frame, medium-close shot, bookshelf background, stays static across most of video
layout.safe_zones: top 10% and bottom 12% kept clear of dense UI; captions placed lower-third over chest
layout.caption_pos: lower-third, one short word/phrase per beat, sometimes split top+bottom (e.g. 'it's' top-left, 'set up' large center)

transitions: hard cut host <-> full-bg graphic/UI screen
b&w desaturation flash on host during fast-recap beats
floating pill-chip icons drifting in bg

themeable: headline font pairing (serif-italic + bold sans combo)
icon/logo used in orbit + bottom bumper
